readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen (thirteen minutes to eleven by Rosa's kitchen clock)
The temple struck eleven, while Lina was still in the kitchen
Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
The kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: Madame's piano played for thirteen minutes (from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock)
whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:47 by the kitchen clock.
Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven.
Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen.
Rosa and Lina heard Madame's piano while Lina was with Rosa.
Madame was playing the piano from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock.
Rosa was in the kitchen when the hall clock struck eleven.
When it was time for the toast, Rosa went up the stairs to fetch the master.
The master was on the floor of the atelier, by his bench, when Rosa found him.
After finding the master, Rosa went down the stairs.
